_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored — never commit real values.

owncast._comment: RTMP ingest. Use a tailnet/LAN address — RTMP is plaintext and carries the key in the handshake.
owncast._comment2: Optional: HTTP API for stream title / status. Leave blank to disable.

library._comment: Jellyfin reports paths as ITS process sees them. Map them to what this machine sees. Longest prefix wins.

encoder._comment: backend: auto | vaapi | qsv | nvenc | amf | videotoolbox | x264
encoder._comment2: gopSeconds must divide Owncast's HLS segment length. 2 is the documented value.

_comment3: Chain scripts are written into `cache` alongside the clips they reference.

normalizer._comment: How many clips ahead of the playhead to keep normalized.
